   "source": [
    "<!-- SPDX-FileCopyrightText: 2026 Orbital Research Cluster for Celestial Applications (ORCCA) Lab, University of Colorado at Boulder -->\n",
    "<!-- SPDX-License-Identifier: ISC -->\n",
    "\n",
    "# ArrayWUnits and ArrayWFrame\n",
    "---\n",
    "*Last revised 2026*\n",
    "\n",
    "This tutorial introduces the two core data containers that flow through every\n",
    "Scarabaeus workflow:\n",
    "\n",
    "- `ArrayWUnits`: Numerical array **+** physical units (km, km/s, ...)\n",
    "- `ArrayWFrame`: Numerical array **+** units **+** reference frame (J2000, ITRF93, ...)\n",
    "\n",
    "**Contents**\n",
    "\n",
    "1. Dimensions and Units — `Units`, `Dimensions`\n",
    "2. `ArrayWUnits` — construction, arithmetic, conversion, safety checks\n",
    "3. Frames — `Frame.generate_common_frames`, DCM, full transformation\n",
    "4. `ArrayWFrame` — construction, frame conversion, frame-aware arithmetic"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "id": "1",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "## 0. Imports and Setup"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 1,
   "id": "2",
   "metadata": {
    "execution": {
     "iopub.execute_input": "2026-10-19T19:40:32.029129Z",
     "iopub.status.busy": "2026-10-19T19:40:32.028960Z",
     "iopub.status.idle": "2026-10-19T19:40:32.471590Z",
     "shell.execute_reply": "2026-10-19T19:40:32.471044Z"
    }
   },
   "outputs": [
    {
     "name": "stdout",
     "output_type": "stream",
     "text": [
      "SCB supplementary data up to date.\n"
     ]
    }
   ],
   "source": [
    "import scarabaeus as scb\n",
    "import supplementary as supp\n",
    "\n",
    "import numpy as np\n",
    "\n",
    "# load tutorial data\n",
    "data = supp.load_data()\n",
    "\n",
    "# load kernels\n",
    "scb.SpiceManager.clear_kernels()\n",
    "scb.SpiceManager.load_kernel_from_mkfile(data.mk.path)"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "id": "3",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "## 1. Dimensions and Units\n",
    "\n",
    "Scarabaeus tracks physical dimensions through every arithmetic operation.\n",
    "`Units.get_units()` returns unit objects that carry both scale and dimension."
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 2,
   "id": "4",
   "metadata": {
    "execution": {
     "iopub.execute_input": "2026-10-19T19:40:32.472914Z",
     "iopub.status.busy": "2026-10-19T19:40:32.472808Z",
     "iopub.status.idle": "2026-10-19T19:40:32.475541Z",
     "shell.execute_reply": "2026-10-19T19:40:32.475087Z"
    }
   },
   "outputs": [
    {
     "name": "stdout",
     "output_type": "stream",
     "text": [
      "km   : km   dimensions → Length\n",
      "m    : m    dimensions → Length\n",
      "sec  : sec  dimensions → Time\n",
      "deg  : deg  dimensions → Angle\n",
      "kg   : kg   dimensions → Mass\n"
     ]
    }
   ],
   "source": [
    "km, m, sec, day, rad, deg, kg = scb.Units.get_units(\n",
    "    ['km', 'm', 'sec', 'day', 'rad', 'deg', 'kg'])\n",
    "\n",
    "print(f\"km   : {km}   dimensions → {km.dimensions}\")\n",
    "print(f\"m    : {m}    dimensions → {m.dimensions}\")\n",
    "print(f\"sec  : {sec}  dimensions → {sec.dimensions}\")\n",
    "print(f\"deg  : {deg}  dimensions → {deg.dimensions}\")\n",
    "print(f\"kg   : {kg}   dimensions → {kg.dimensions}\")"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 3,
   "id": "5",
   "metadata": {
    "execution": {
     "iopub.execute_input": "2026-10-19T19:40:32.476710Z",
     "iopub.status.busy": "2026-10-19T19:40:32.476626Z",
     "iopub.status.idle": "2026-10-19T19:40:32.479033Z",
     "shell.execute_reply": "2026-10-19T19:40:32.478571Z"
    }
   },
   "outputs": [
    {
     "name": "stdout",
     "output_type": "stream",
     "text": [
      "km/sec     : km/sec   → Velocity\n",
      "km/sec²    : km/sec^2   → Acceleration\n",
      "km²        : km^2  → Area\n",
      "sec⁻¹      : Hz  → per Time\n",
      "km * kg    : kg*km    → Mass times Length\n"
     ]
    }
   ],
   "source": [
    "# Unit arithmetic propagates dimensions automatically\n",
    "vel_unit   = km / sec\n",
    "acc_unit   = km / sec**2\n",
    "area_unit  = km**2\n",
    "freq_unit  = sec**-1\n",
    "\n",
    "print(f\"km/sec     : {vel_unit}   → {vel_unit.dimensions}\")\n",
    "print(f\"km/sec²    : {acc_unit}   → {acc_unit.dimensions}\")\n",
    "print(f\"km²        : {area_unit}  → {area_unit.dimensions}\")\n",
    "print(f\"sec⁻¹      : {freq_unit}  → {freq_unit.dimensions}\")\n",
    "print(f\"km * kg    : {km * kg}    → {(km * kg).dimensions}\")"
   ]
  },
  {

   "id": "6",

   "source": [
    "## 2. `ArrayWUnits`\n",
    "\n",
    "`ArrayWUnits` wraps a NumPy array together with its physical units.\n",
    "The units travel with the array through every mathematical operation."
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 4,
   "id": "7",
   "metadata": {
    "execution": {
     "iopub.execute_input": "2026-10-19T19:40:32.480136Z",
     "iopub.status.busy": "2026-10-19T19:40:32.480053Z",
     "iopub.status.idle": "2026-10-19T19:40:32.482205Z",
     "shell.execute_reply": "2026-10-19T19:40:32.481853Z"
    }
   },
   "outputs": [
    {
     "name": "stdout",
     "output_type": "stream",
     "text": [
      "Altitude  : 408.0 km\n",
      "Period    : 5552.0 sec\n",
      "Mass      : 419725.0 kg\n",
      "altitude.values : 408.0   (raw float)\n",
      "altitude.units  : km\n"
     ]
    }
   ],
   "source": [
    "# ── Scalars ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n",
    "altitude   = scb.ArrayWUnits(408.0,   km)     # ISS altitude\n",
    "period     = scb.ArrayWUnits(5552.0,  sec)    # ISS orbital period\n",

    "\n",
    "print(f\"Altitude  : {altitude}\")\n",
    "print(f\"Period    : {period}\")\n",
    "print(f\"Mass      : {dry_mass}\")\n",
    "print(f\"altitude.values : {altitude.values}   (raw float)\")\n",
    "print(f\"altitude.units  : {altitude.units}\")"
   ]
  },

   "cell_type": "code",

   "id": "8",
   "metadata": {

    "# ── Homogeneous vector (all elements share one unit) ─────────────\n",

    "vel = scb.ArrayWUnits(np.array([-1.2,     6.8,    3.1  ]), km/sec)\n",

    "print(\"Position [km] :\", pos)\n",

    "state = scb.ArrayWUnits(\n",

    "    [km, km, km, km/sec, km/sec, km/sec],\n",
    ")\n",
    "print(\"State vector (mixed units):\")\n",
    "print(f\"  values : {state.values}\")\n",
    "print(f\"  units  : {state.units}\")"
   ]

   "source": [
    "## 3. Frames\n",
    "\n",
    "A `Frame` object holds the SPICE frame name and ID.\n",
    "`Frame.generate_common_frames()` returns four frames used throughout Scarabaeus."

  {
   "cell_type": "code",

     ]
    }
   ],
   "source": [
    "J2000, ITRF93, ECLIPJ2000, IAUEARTH = scb.Frame.generate_common_frames()\n",
    "\n",
    "for fr in [J2000, ITRF93, ECLIPJ2000, IAUEARTH]:\n",

   ]

   "source": [
    "## 4. Frame Transformations\n",
    "\n",
    "`Frame.get_DCM` returns the 3×3 Direction Cosine Matrix (rotation only).\n",
    "`Frame.get_transformation` returns the 6×6 state-transformation matrix (rotation + rate)."
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 10,
   "id": "15",
   "metadata": {
    "execution": {
     "iopub.execute_input": "2026-10-19T19:40:32.499225Z",
     "iopub.status.busy": "2026-10-19T19:40:32.499165Z",
     "iopub.status.idle": "2026-10-19T19:40:32.501866Z",
     "shell.execute_reply": "2026-10-19T19:40:32.501491Z"
    }
   },
   "outputs": [
    {
     "name": "stdout",
     "output_type": "stream",
     "text": [
      "DCM shape  : (3, 3)\n",
      "DCM (J2000→IAUEARTH):\n",
      "[[-7.63801e-01 -6.45449e-01  2.08100e-03]\n",
      " [ 6.45446e-01 -7.63803e-01 -1.77000e-03]\n",
      " [ 2.73200e-03 -9.00000e-06  9.99996e-01]]\n",
      "\n",
      "||R @ Rᵀ − I||₂ = 2.71e-16  (should be ~0)\n"
     ]
    }
   ],
   "source": [
    "# ── Define an epoch ──────────────────────────────────────────────\n",
    "et0    = scb.SpiceManager.jd2et(2461809.72995654)   # arbitrary JD\n",
    "epoch  = scb.EpochArray(np.array([et0]), sys='TDB')\n",
    "\n",
    "# ── Direction Cosine Matrix: J2000 → IAUEARTH ────────────────────\n",
    "# get_DCM returns a plain numpy ndarray (shape 3×3)\n",
    "R = scb.Frame.get_DCM(source_frame=J2000, target_frame=IAUEARTH, epoch=epoch)\n",
    "\n",
    "print(f\"DCM shape  : {R.shape}\")\n",
    "print(f\"DCM (J2000→IAUEARTH):\\n{np.round(R, 6)}\")\n",
    "\n",
    "# ── Verify it is orthogonal: R @ Rᵀ ≈ I ─────────────────────────\n",
    "RRT = R @ R.T\n",
    "print(f\"\\n||R @ Rᵀ − I||₂ = {np.linalg.norm(RRT - np.eye(3)):.2e}  (should be ~0)\")"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 11,
   "id": "16",
   "metadata": {
    "execution": {
     "iopub.execute_input": "2026-10-19T19:40:32.502827Z",
     "iopub.status.busy": "2026-10-19T19:40:32.502761Z",
     "iopub.status.idle": "2026-10-19T19:40:32.505307Z",
     "shell.execute_reply": "2026-10-19T19:40:32.504977Z"
    }
   },
   "outputs": [
    {
     "name": "stdout",
     "output_type": "stream",
     "text": [
      "Transformation matrix shape : (4, 4)\n",
      "Upper-left 3×3 (rotation):\n",
      "[[-7.63801e-01 -6.45449e-01  2.08100e-03]\n",
      " [ 6.45446e-01 -7.63803e-01 -1.77000e-03]\n",
      " [ 2.73200e-03 -9.00000e-06  9.99996e-01]]\n",
      "Translation column (km)  : [ 2.69516128e+07 -1.39474250e+08  3.83428136e+07]\n"
     ]
    }
   ],
   "source": [
    "# ── Full state-transformation matrix (4×4 homogeneous) ───────────\n",
    "# get_transformation returns a list; each element is an ArrayWUnits\n",
    "T_list = scb.Frame.get_transformation(\n",
    "    source_frame=J2000, target_frame=IAUEARTH, epoch=epoch)\n",
    "\n",
    "T_mat = np.array(T_list[0].values)   # (4, 4) numpy array\n",
    "print(f\"Transformation matrix shape : {T_mat.shape}\")\n",
    "print(f\"Upper-left 3×3 (rotation):\\n{np.round(T_mat[:3, :3], 6)}\")\n",
    "print(f\"Translation column (km)  : {np.round(T_mat[:3, 3], 3)}\")"
   ]
  },

   "source": [
    "## 5. `ArrayWFrame`\n",
    "\n",
    "`ArrayWFrame` adds a reference frame to an `ArrayWUnits` so that\n",
    "frame-incompatible operations are caught at runtime."
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 12,
   "id": "18",
   "metadata": {
    "execution": {
     "iopub.execute_input": "2026-10-19T19:40:32.506344Z",
     "iopub.status.busy": "2026-10-19T19:40:32.506285Z",
     "iopub.status.idle": "2026-10-19T19:40:32.508734Z",
     "shell.execute_reply": "2026-10-19T19:40:32.508355Z"
    }
   },
   "outputs": [
    {
     "name": "stdout",
     "output_type": "stream",
     "text": [
      "Form 1 (ArrayWUnits + Frame):\n",
      "  values : [ 7000. -1200.  3500.]\n",
      "  units  : km\n",
      "  frame  : J2000 (0 - SOLAR SYSTEM BARYCENTER)\n",
      "\n",
      "Form 2 (array + units + frame):\n",
      "  values : [ 7000. -1200.  3500.]\n",
      "  frame  : J2000 (0 - SOLAR SYSTEM BARYCENTER)\n"
     ]
    }
   ],
   "source": [
    "# ── Constructor form 1: ArrayWUnits + Frame ──────────────────────\n",
    "pos_awu  = scb.ArrayWUnits(np.array([7000.0, -1200.0, 3500.0]), km)\n",
    "pos_j2k  = scb.ArrayWFrame(pos_awu, J2000)\n",
    "\n",
    "print(\"Form 1 (ArrayWUnits + Frame):\")\n",
    "print(f\"  values : {pos_j2k.quantity.values}\")\n",
    "print(f\"  units  : {pos_j2k.quantity.units}\")\n",
    "print(f\"  frame  : {pos_j2k.frame}\")\n",
    "print()\n",
    "\n",
    "# ── Constructor form 2: ndarray + Units + Frame ───────────────────\n",
    "pos_j2k2 = scb.ArrayWFrame(np.array([7000.0, -1200.0, 3500.0]), km, J2000)\n",
    "\n",
    "print(\"Form 2 (array + units + frame):\")\n",
    "print(f\"  values : {pos_j2k2.quantity.values}\")\n",
    "print(f\"  frame  : {pos_j2k2.frame}\")"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 13,

    "# ── Frame conversion: J2000 → IAUEARTH at a single epoch ─────────\n",
    "# convert_to operates IN-PLACE and returns None — save original first\n",
    "pos_j2k = scb.ArrayWFrame(np.array([7000.0, -1200.0, 3500.0]), km, J2000)\n",
    "orig_vals = np.array(pos_j2k.quantity.values)   # snapshot before conversion\n",
    "\n",
    "pos_j2k.convert_to(IAUEARTH, epoch)             # in-place: frame updated\n",
    "earth_vals = np.array(pos_j2k.quantity.values)\n",
    "\n",
    "print(\"\\nFrame conversion (J2000 → IAUEARTH):\")\n",
    "print(f\"J2000    (before) : {np.round(orig_vals, 3)} km\")\n",
    "print(f\"IAUEARTH (after)  : {np.round(earth_vals, 3)} km\")\n",
    "print(f\"|r| J2000    = {np.linalg.norm(orig_vals):.4f} km\")\n",
    "print(f\"|r| IAUEARTH = {np.linalg.norm(earth_vals):.4f} km  (must be equal)\")\n"
   ]

    "# ── Same-frame arithmetic ─────────────────────────────────────────\n",
    "r1 = scb.ArrayWFrame(np.array([1000.0, 200.0, 300.0]), km, J2000)\n",
    "r2 = scb.ArrayWFrame(np.array([ 500.0, 100.0, 150.0]), km, J2000)\n",
    "\n",
    "print(\"Same-frame addition (J2000 + J2000):\")\n",
    "print(f\"  {r1.quantity.values} + {r2.quantity.values}\")\n",
    "print(f\"  = {(r1 + r2).quantity.values}  km  ✓\")\n",
    "print()\n",
    "\n",
    "# ── Cross-frame arithmetic is blocked ────────────────────────────\n",
    "r_itrf = scb.ArrayWFrame(np.array([4.0, 5.0, 6.0]), km, ITRF93)\n",
    "\n",
    "print(\"Cross-frame addition (J2000 + ITRF93)  — should be blocked:\")\n",
    "try:\n",
    "    _ = r1 + r_itrf\n",
    "    print(\"  FAIL — should have raised an error\")\n",
    "except Exception as e:\n",
    "    print(f\"  Blocked ✓  ({type(e).__name__})\")\n",
    "print()\n",
    "\n",
    "# ── Cross-unit arithmetic is blocked ─────────────────────────────\n",
    "vel_j2k = scb.ArrayWFrame(np.array([1.0, 2.0, 3.0]), km/sec, J2000)\n",
    "\n",
    "print(\"Cross-unit addition (km + km/s in J2000)  — should be blocked:\")\n",
    "try:\n",
    "    _ = r1 + vel_j2k\n",
    "    print(\"  FAIL — should have raised an error\")\n",
    "except Exception as e:\n",
    "    print(f\"  Blocked ✓  ({type(e).__name__})\")"
   ]

   "source": [
    "## Summary\n",
    "\n",
    "| Concept | Class | Key methods |\n",
    "|---------|-------|-------------|\n",
    "| Physical units | `Units` | `get_units()`, arithmetic (`/`, `*`, `**`) |\n",
    "| Array + units | `ArrayWUnits` | `.values`, `.units`, `.convert_to()`, `+−×÷` |\n",
    "| Coordinate frame | `Frame` | `generate_common_frames()`, `get_DCM()`, `get_transformation()` |\n",
    "| Array + units + frame | `ArrayWFrame` | `.quantity`, `.frame`, `.convert_to(frame, epoch)`, `+−` |\n",
    "\n",
    "**Key safety guarantees**\n",
    "\n",
    "* `ArrayWUnits` blocks addition/subtraction between incompatible dimensions (km + km/s raises `ValueError`)\n",
    "* `ArrayWFrame` blocks arithmetic between different frames (J2000 + ITRF93 raises an exception)\n",
    "* Frame conversions require an epoch because the rotation matrix is time-varying\n",
    "\n",
    "These guarantees propagate through all Scarabaeus dynamics, filter, and measurement modules."
   ]
  },
